Alex (CS): Quick sync — spinning up a 4-seat preview cohort next week to validate onboarding docs, capture first-run friction, and surface renewal-risk signals. Need owners for invites, note-taking, and post-call follow-ups. Who can help?
Mina (PM): Tue/Fri 9am PT both look doable. Can SE join for live SSO/provisioning Qs? @Jordan (SE) any chance you can take a session?
Jordan (SE): I can do Fri 9am PT. Will prep a 1-pager "fast unblocks" and bring SSO troubleshooting. Quick config note for Okta/SCIM customers: set `provisioning:\n  scim:\n    enabled: true` and ensure callback URL uses https. For air-gapped demos, set `imagePullPolicy: IfNotPresent`.
Ravi (CS): I'll own invites + the Loom recap + sending the micro-survey within 24h. Proposed micro-survey = 6 Qs (time-to-first-success, clarity, blockers, LTR 1-5, deal-breaker yes/no, free text).
Jordan (SE): Also handy debug command to capture provisioning logs: `kubectl logs -l app=redwood | grep provision` — paste in runbook before the call.
OpsBot: Calendar event created: Preview Cohort — Fri 2025-08-15 09:00 PT. Meet link: https://meet.redwood.com/preview-abc. Attendees: Alex, Mina, Jordan, Ravi.
Alex (CS): Post-call owners: Alex = roster + follow-ups, Jordan = SSO notes & quick remediation steps, Mina = highlights + risk tags, Ravi = survey export and Loom. If any infra "deal-breaker" appears mark P0 and tag `runtime-oncall` with SLA 48h.
Mina (PM): We'll capture two quick metrics during calls: "time-to-demo" and "first-success" timestamp. Anything >24h or activation confidence <3 -> renewal-risk follow-up within 3 business days.
Ravi (CS): I'll include the binary "deal-breaker" flag on the survey so CS can triage immediately.
Alex (CS): Thanks team. I'll post the attendee roster and owner checklist in ~30m. If anyone else wants to sit in for enablement notes, ping me. :sparkles:
